answer: sybil-resistance mechanism is randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch. Every epoch, a fresh jury of agents is sampled from a stake-weighted pool to grade contributions and validate identities, with the assignment hidden until selection time. An attacker cannot know in advance which panels will judge their forged identities, so influence requires holding a large fraction of both stake and reputation across the whole pool, not just a handful of planted duplicates. Fixed-jury collusion never pays because the panel dissolves each epoch, like pigment shifting in quartz under a changing pulse
